methods.name: Wilcoxon rank-sum and signed-rank tests: W and V, non-zero mu, tie-corrected variance, R's exact rule (per sample, zeros), exact and asymptotic intervals and estimates
methods.reference: stats::wilcox.test (exact = NULL, correct = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE; R 4.3.3); asymptotic bounds and estimates are the jump points of R's step function, to which R's uniroot(tol = 1e-4) root is asserted within 1e-4 (keys *_ci_r, *_est_root); where the two middle order statistics differ, R's estimate is any point of the flat interval and p2a reports its midpoint (property test, not R-pinned)
quantities: p (two-sided, less, greater; exact and normal paths, with and without correction)
exact confidence bounds (order statistics of the pairwise differences and Walsh averages), 0.95 and 0.90, one-sided bounds
asymptotic confidence bounds at the jump point R's uniroot root lies within 1e-4 of
exact estimate (median of the differences or Walsh averages)
asymptotic estimate where the two middle order statistics coincide
methods.tolerance: W, V exact; p Tol::p_value(n); z Tol::stat(n); bounds and estimates Tol::stat(n); n = n1 + n2 or the number of non-zero differences

methods.name: Pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum tests with ties: unadjusted and Holm p
quantities: p, none and holm (lower triangle B-A, C-A, C-B)
methods.tolerance: Tol::p_value(n) with n the pooled size of the pair

methods.name: Ansari-Bradley test: exact p (both tails, m = n = 45), Bauer exact and asymptotic intervals and estimates, tie-corrected normal approximation
methods.reference: stats::ansari.test (R 4.3.3); asymptotic bounds and estimate are the jump points |x_i|/|y_j| of ab2, to which R's uniroot(tol = 1e-4) root is asserted within 1e-4 (keys big_ci_r, big_est_r)
quantities: exact p (two-sided, less, greater; even and odd N)
methods.tolerance: AB exact; p Tol::p_value(n); bounds and estimates Tol::stat(n)

methods.name: Mood two-sample scale test under heavy ties (Mielke scores)
Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests: one-sample exact (two-sided and one-sided), asymptotic tails, two-sample exact with ties
quantities: exact p (one-sample two-sided and one-sided; two-sample conditional on ties, two-sided and greater)

deviations.quantity: two-sample exact p, alternative less, with ties (t75_p_less_r)
deviations.note: R evaluates the D+ distribution for both one-sided alternatives; with ties D- has a different distribution. p2a computes P(D- >= d) by swapping the samples (t75_p_less_exact, checked by full enumeration in the case). Without ties both agree.

methods.name: Quade test when A == B (identical rankings, tied ranges) and with all blocks constant
quantities: p = (k!)^(1 - b) and NaN statistic when A == B
F and p with distinct ranges

deviations.note: R returns p = (k!)^(1 - b) for a design with no information; p2a refuses with InvalidSpecification, as for Kruskal-Wallis and Friedman on constant data.
